# Northline Budget Guides

> Free guides to budgeting by paycheck (weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly) from Northline Budget, which sells a Paycheck Budget Spreadsheet for Google Sheets and Excel.

## Guides
- [How to Budget When You're Paid Every Two Weeks](https://vasilpanchovski-glitch.github.io/northlinebudget/how-to-budget-biweekly-paychecks/): A step-by-step biweekly budget: match every bill to the paycheck before it's due, plan 26 paychecks a year, and know what's left to spend.
- [Three-Paycheck Months in 2027 (Biweekly Pay)](https://vasilpanchovski-glitch.github.io/northlinebudget/three-paycheck-months/): Which months of 2027 have three paydays if you're paid biweekly on Fridays, and how to use the extra paycheck.
- [Sinking Funds: How to Save for Costs You Know Are Coming](https://vasilpanchovski-glitch.github.io/northlinebudget/sinking-funds/): What a sinking fund is, how to calculate how much to save per paycheck, and a list of sinking fund ideas.
- [Debt Snowball vs Debt Avalanche: Which Should You Use?](https://vasilpanchovski-glitch.github.io/northlinebudget/debt-snowball-vs-avalanche/): How the debt snowball and debt avalanche methods work, an example with three debts, and how to choose.
- [How to Budget Twice-a-Month Pay (15th and 30th)](https://vasilpanchovski-glitch.github.io/northlinebudget/semi-monthly-budget/): A semi-monthly budget: 24 paychecks a year, which bills go on which paycheck, and how it differs from biweekly pay.
- [What Is a Paycheck Budget?](https://vasilpanchovski-glitch.github.io/northlinebudget/what-is-a-paycheck-budget/): A paycheck budget plans each paycheck instead of the whole month. How it works and who it's for.

## Product
- [Paycheck Budget Spreadsheet](https://northlinebudget.gumroad.com/l/paycheck-budget): $24, Google Sheets and Excel, every payday of the year planned, bills, sinking funds, debt snowball/avalanche.
